title: From Item Scores to Semantic Tokens: Test-Time Collaborative Adaptation for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32098v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommenders using semantic identifiers predict items through successive token decisions, but beam search may irreversibly prune promising item paths. This limitation is particularly consequential when a few recent interactions signal an emerging interest while earlier behavior favors established preferences. Yet an independently trained discriminative recommender may rank the same items highly from the same interaction history. Such complementary scores are available at test time, offering a way to adapt a frozen generator without retraining either model. The challenge is to use these scores before pruning: combining completed recommendation lists cannot alter earlier beam decisions, while scores over complete items cannot directly inform choices among semantic prefixes shared by multiple items. translated_title: 从物品评分到语义标记：面向生成式推荐的测试时协同自适应
translated_abstract: 使用语义标识符的生成式推荐器通过连续的标记决策来预测物品，但束搜索可能会不可逆地剪枝掉有前景的物品路径。当少量近期交互表明一种新兴兴趣、而早期行为偏向既有偏好时，这一局限性尤为严重。然而，一个独立训练的判别式推荐器可能基于相同的交互历史对相同的物品给出高分排名。这类互补的评分在测试时即可获得，从而提供了一种无需重新训练任何模型即可适配冻结生成器的途径。挑战在于如何在剪枝发生之前利用这些评分：合并已完成的推荐列表无法改变早期的束搜索决策，而针对完整物品的评分也无法直接指导在多个物品共享的语义前缀之间做出选择。我们提出了测试时协同束搜索自适应（TCBSA），这是一种训练……
tldr: 提出TCBSA方法，在测试时利用独立判别式推荐器的互补评分来引导冻结生成式推荐器的束搜索前缀决策，无需重新训练即可缓解新兴兴趣被剪枝遗漏的问题。
en_tdlr: TCBSA adapts a frozen generative recommender's beam search at test time by leveraging complementary scores from an independently trained discriminative recommender, avoiding irreversible pruning of emerging-interest items without retraining either model.
